svg.title: The same PD on the drum axis with two update periods
svg.desc: Updated every 0.02 seconds, the axis reaches the 0.01 radian target without overshoot and stays within 0.0001 radians from 1.68 seconds. Updated every 0.6 seconds, its first torque waits one period; the angle overshoots to 0.088 radians at 1.94 seconds and passes minus 0.2 radians at 2.82 seconds, where the abort brakes it to rest at minus 0.31 radians.
svg.text: The same PD on the drum axis, updated every 0.02 s and every 0.6 s
Control Studio recording of this project · target 0 → 0.01 rad at 0 s · numbers answer the predictions
First torque 0.16 N·m: after 0.02 s, and after 0.6 s for the slow loop
No overshoot; within 0.0001 rad from 1.68 s
Overshoots to 0.088 rad at 1.94 s, passes −0.2 rad at 2.82 s, rests at −0.31 rad
